other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow of an ex‑serviceman of rank Havildar or below.
Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
The assistance is limited to a maximum of two daughters per widow.
Daughters must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage.
Daughter’s name must be recorded in the ex‑serviceman’s discharge book or Part‑2 order.
Applicant must possess a valid Ex‑Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the District Sainik Welfare Office.
Applicant must not have received marriage assistance from the Kendriya Sainik Board.
Widows classified as Battle Casualties or Physical Casualties are ineligible.
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of marriage through the same District Sainik Welfare Officer who issued the identity card.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 per daughter, up to two daughters.
